chile-andes-and-caj-n-del-maipo.title: Chile · Andes and Cajón del Maipo
chile-andes-and-caj-n-del-maipo.slogan: A 174 km loop out of San José de Maipo
chile-andes-and-caj-n-del-maipo.story: High Andes scenery close enough to feel unreal. It goes by way of Embalse El Yeso, Baños Morales and Pirque. The highest point is about 3,700 m. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.

kiel-husum-north-sea-long-day.title: Kiel · Husum North Sea Long Day
kiel-husum-north-sea-long-day.slogan: A 254 km loop out of Rendsburg canal
kiel-husum-north-sea-long-day.story: A bigger wind-and-water day: only pick it when the weather is kind. The best part sits around Rendsburg canal, Friedrichstadt stop, Husum harbour, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.
